name: io.github.kKEo/memors
description: Local, explainable knowledge base for AI agents: hybrid search with provenance over SQLite.

environmentVariables.name: MEMORS_KB
environmentVariables.description: Name of the knowledge base to open; one SQLite file per name under $MEMORS_HOME/kb/.

environmentVariables.name: MEMORS_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Base directory for knowledge bases and settings (default ~/.memors-mcp).

environmentVariables.name: MEMORS_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Embedding model id from `memors-mcp model ls` (default granite-small-r2).
